info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Terminal Configuration API
info.description: The Card Terminal Configuration API enables businesses to manage and update configurations for their card terminals dynamically. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify specific parameters to optimize terminal performance and adapt to changing operational needs. Primarily utilized by banking institutions and payment service providers, the API supports use cases such as adjusting transaction settings and enhancing security measures. This streamlined approach ensures that card terminals are always aligned with the latest compliance standards and customer preferences.

patch.description: This operation updates the configuration or settings related to the specific card terminal administration identified by CARD-400045. Ensure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to apply the desired changes.
